items.example: If you skip the warm-up, you run the risk of injury.
items.simple: You do something where a bad thing could happen.

items.example: He's still coming to terms with the loss.
items.simple: You slowly accept something sad that you cannot change.

items.example: That idea is utterly ridiculous!
items.simple: So silly that nobody can take it seriously.

items.example: He has a great sense of humour.
items.simple: You can see what is funny and you laugh easily.

items.example: Don't draw conclusions before you know the facts.
items.simple: After thinking, you decide what is true.

items.example: We finally reached an agreement after hours of talking.
items.exampleTr: Saatlerce konuştuktan sonra sonunda anlaşmaya vardık.
items.simple: After talking, everyone says yes to the same thing.

items.example: I always try to keep my promises.
items.simple: You do what you said you would do.

items.example: I'm deeply concerned about my brother.
items.simple: You feel a lot of worry about someone or something.

items.example: It's highly unlikely that he'll come.
items.simple: It almost will not happen.

items.example: I'm fully aware of the problem.
items.simple: You know about it very well.

items.example: It was bitterly cold at the bus stop.
items.exampleTr: Otobüs durağında dondurucu bir soğuk vardı.
items.simple: The weather is very, very cold and hurts your face.

items.example: The shop sells a wide range of cheap phones.
items.exampleTr: Mağaza geniş çeşitte ucuz telefon satıyor.
items.simple: Many different kinds of things.

items.example: Please take responsibility for your own mistakes.
items.simple: You say 'it was me' and you fix it.

items.example: It'll save us money in the long run.
items.simple: After a lot of time has passed, not just now.

items.tr: kapmak, alışmak, işin püf noktasını öğrenmek
items.example: I'm finally getting the hang of this game.
items.simple: You slowly learn how to do a new thing.

items.example: That was a narrow escape. The car almost hit us!
items.exampleTr: Kıl payı kurtulduk. Araba neredeyse bize çarpıyordu!
items.simple: You almost get hurt, but you are safe in the end.

items.example: They had a heated argument about politics.
items.exampleTr: Siyaset hakkında hararetli bir tartışma yaptılar.
items.simple: Two people are shouting and are very angry with each other.

items.example: I can't tell the difference between the twins.
items.simple: You can see how two things are not the same.

items.example: I was on the verge of tears.
items.simple: You are very, very close to doing something.

items.example: He kept his cool even when they shouted.
items.simple: You stay calm when things are hard.

items.example: He paid me a nice compliment on my shirt.
items.exampleTr: Gömleğim hakkında güzel bir iltifatta bulundu.
items.simple: You say something nice about someone.

items.example: Parents should set a good example.
items.simple: You do the right thing so others copy you.

items.example: Biting my nails is a hard habit to break.
items.exampleTr: Tırnak yemek bırakması zor bir alışkanlık.
items.simple: You stop doing something you always did.
